listing.aiSummary: Provides a Kotlin DSL for building vanilla-style UI objects with flexible layouts and components.

description:
StarUILib

A Kotlin UI library for Starsector mods
Only install it if a mod requires it. It does nothing on its own, saves nothing, and is safe to add or remove mid-save.

Requires LazyLib 3.1 and PatchLib.

For mod authors

Building UI in Starsector usually means TooltipMakerAPI, CustomPanelAPI and a bunch of manual pixel peaping. StarUILib is a Kotlin DSL in the style of Jetpack Compose, written to build vanilla UI objects. Highly flexible layout, input, rendering, and state updates are added to those objects through PatchLib, so any UI is as close to vanilla as possible.

What's in it
Column, Row, Box and AnchorPanel layouts, with sizes per axis (exact, fill, wrap), padding, margins and spacers
Scrolling on any container, per axis, and LazyColumn / LazyRow for long lists
Buttons, checkboxes, radio groups, text fields, sliders, progress bars, sortable tables and tooltips
Vanilla parts as components: stat grids, fleet and cargo lists, skill panels / icons, planet info, the sector map and more
Dialogs, overlays and toasts that work on any screen
UI on the title screen, the campaign, combat and every core tab, or inject() is anywhere else (PatchLib hook recommended)
findAll() and dumpLayout() to read any panel's tree, vanilla's included, for debugging and tests

Getting started
Press Ctrl + Shift + U in game (title screen, campaign or combat) for the showcase: every feature with a live demo next to the code that makes it. The samples and showcase are CC0, copy them freely.
Add staruilib to your mod_info.json dependencies.
Wiki coming... When I get around to it.

This is an alpha. The API might change before 1.0 (although very unlikely).
Feedback and bug reports are very welcome, here or on the USC Discord.

Source

github.com/Starficz/StarUILib

Credits

Alex: for making the game.
Lukas04: for PatchLib, which every StarUILib hook runs on.
LazyWizard: for LazyLib and its Kotlin runtime.

AI use disclaimer
A lot of code in this mod was created/modified/refactored using AI tools (Claude Code)
Everything has been unit tested, with manual checking for all features.
A UI Lib was something I have always been wanting to make, but of course never had time to do so.
Using LLM's to finish this project that's been on the backburner was a reasonable choice for me.

Changelog
Version 1.0.0-alpha.2
- Renamed from StarUIFramework to StarUILib (mod id staruilib)
- Requires LazyLib 3.1
- AnchorPanel, dialogs that size to their content, findAll, TooltipMakerPanel, SkillIcon, Modifier.hoverState
- Fixes for injections

Version 1.0.0-alpha
- First alpha testing release
